capabilities: Append WeChat text, voice, image, file and video messages to a daily Markdown file
Write into a dedicated section of existing daily notes, creating them from a template if needed
Transcribe voice messages and save the original audio as WAV attachments
Clip WeChat official-account articles with title, body text and images
Send a WeChat reminder when nothing has been recorded by a set time
extras: Desktop-only and only works while Obsidian is running (offline messages are backfilled within ~24 hours). ClawBot access is being rolled out gradually by Tencent since 2026-03 and is mostly unavailable to overseas-registered WeChat accounts. The author lists exactly which remote endpoints are contacted and states there is no telemetry; a WeChat QR-code donation link is included.
intentEvidence: 前身 Python 版 wechat-diary 已归档(2026-08)
problem: Capturing a quick thought from your phone normally means opening Obsidian and typing; this records messages straight from a WeChat chat into the vault while desktop Obsidian runs.
